stage: Pre-output criteria. No new encounter art inspected. Root requests freeze before generation.

criteria.observable_check: Faces act, silhouettes carry personality, and the actual line, paint, value and material treatment remain recognizable across the four moments. Judge Black Petal, Iron Orchard, Soft Thunder and Sunbreak in their own systems; do not impose Nightglass or assume an intended style label proves realization.

Setup establishes a usable relation; commitment exposes a risk; reversal changes who controls the encounter; consequence shows a specific lasting result or cost. Credit body compression, recoil, balance loss, restraint and altered choices. A grip diagram or burst alone is not an exciting action, and repeated airborne targets are not automatically distinct powers.

Trace actor, weapon or power source, contact/trigger, target response and consequence from actual pixels. Separate a plausible physical hit from proof of the special rule or timing. Horror rules, grappling pressure, elastic response and power counters should change visible behavior rather than only color the effect.

Check force-bearing limbs, body connections, planted support, weapon count/continuity, actual grip and joint orientation. Preserve known laterality, creature construction and relative scale. Distinguish hidden detail from a proven error; intentional radical crops are allowed when the decisive relation remains legible.

Follow recurring adults, weapons and threat anatomy through camera changes. Track landmarks, contact sides, travel direction, distances, exits and obstacles. Damage, torn clothing, dropped items, severed supports and changed footing must persist or visibly transition; a new angle cannot silently reverse an injury or restore a spent object.

Use actual close, medium, wide, high/low and distance changes to reveal different information and maintain adult recognition. Reward purposeful reactions and consequences as well as peak impacts. Radical views are assessed for their intended composition without pretending multiple changed variables isolate a style effect.

criteria.topic: Quiet surfaces and source-only finish regression
criteria.observable_check: Ground reflections, cracks, debris and repeated surface marks must stay subordinate to the event; broad bright patterning can still compete without fine grain. Compare each finish to its exact actual parent at native and matched phone size. Preserve faces, silhouettes, contact, damage, material character, depth and purposeful force cues. Mark partial/reject if calming the image damages these; do not recommend another pass for an already calm image.

Inspect actual native art, matched phone parent/return views, and each complete four-frame sequence without explanatory captions first. Record where identity, direction, rule or consequence becomes uncertain across adjacent moments. Then compare to the frozen brief; captions and UI integrity cannot stand in for visible comprehension.

report_protocol: Freeze actual native observations before root preferred output verdict whenever available; disclose any prior cues instead of claiming blind review.
Bind every attempt to native image SHA, exact parent when edited, and native/actual-phone review evidence; preserve earlier freezes and disagreement.
Report gains, remaining failures, uncertainty and the strongest plausible counter-reading. Recommend a bounded repair only for a visible material failure; do not spend on beauty variants.
Keep owner praise global. No new votes, canon, comfort/acceptance, numeric beauty grade or successful escape claims from metadata.
Reviewer generates no art, mutates no selections and writes only research/encounter-lab/independent-review.
preflight_watchlist: A four-frame arc can become four unrelated peaks unless the initial contact, cost and altered state remain visible.
Grappling and horror support changes need distinct anatomy/weight consequences, not the same launched opponent used in every style.
Changing camera or source conditioning can silently swap handedness, damage sides, weapons, creature feet or exit geometry.
Surface passes may preserve a structural defect or erase the contact scratch, severed-end gap, tension trace or impact direction that explains the next panel.
